title: KTP Emergency Policy Declaration
description: The emergency capability declaration defined by specifications/emergency-capability.md. This schema constrains configuration shape. scripts/check-emergency-policy.py also checks finite JSON values, roster uniqueness, threshold counts, and predecessor semantics. Neither schema nor checker verifies signatures, independent custody, approval, activation, trusted time, revocation, or runtime enforcement. A declaration alone grants no authority.

predecessor_digest.description: Null only for version 1. Later versions bind the immediately preceding approved policy payload; the checker validates syntax, not chain history.

custodians.description: At least three custodians with separately unique principal_id, key_id, and control_domain values. Independence is asserted metadata, not established by distinct strings. Runtime changes are approved against the pinned incumbent roster, never a candidate roster alone.

change_control.description: approval_threshold must also be at least ceil(0.9 * custodian_count) and no greater than that full count. These floors cannot be waived during an incident. The checker does not establish that a change has met them.

activation.description: threshold cannot exceed the full approved custodian count. Activation still requires runtime verification under the preinstalled approved policy; this declaration is not an activation token.

parameters.description: An exact parameter map: all declared names and scalar values must match, and extra request parameters are denied. Numbers must be finite; arrays and nested objects are not permitted. Strings are literal values, never executable patterns or templates.

evaluation_profile_digest.description: Binds the independent local evaluation profile for demand, capacity, Soul, and other applicable checks; emergency activation cannot override their vetoes.

actions.description: One or more fully enumerated actions with unique action_id values. Wildcards, globs, and templated identities or resource/operation patterns are not accepted.

literal.description: A nonempty literal identifier with no whitespace or wildcard/glob/template delimiters (* ? [ ] { }). Its interpretation must not expand patterns, aliases, or templates.

digest.description: Digest syntax only. Trusted Level 3 deployments require SHA-384 for every emergency binding under KTP-CRYPTO; this declaration schema has no trusted conformance-level context and cannot establish that requirement or permit a downgrade.
